title: AppTest: Adding an element on rerun leads to KeyError in session_state
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When writing tests with AppTest, a rather vexing issue occured, where the page looks for the state of a widget but does not find its corresponding key in the sesssion_state (a situation labeled as "We'll never get here" in the code's comments).
It seems to be caused by dynamically adding elements to the page and changing the value of others, which in turn updates the widget id. Funnily, the app works fine in the browser.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest

import streamlit as st

if '_string_value' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state._string_value = 'string1'

if st.session_state.get('_bool_value', False):
    with st.container(key='k_container'):
        st.html('<style>color: red;</style>')

with st.container():
    st.text_input(
        'Text',
        value=st.session_state._string_value,
    )

    if st.button('Button', key='k_button'):
        st.session_state._string_value = 'string2'
        st.session_state._bool_value = True
        st.rerun()


def test_session_file():
    at = AppTest('test_main.py', default_timeout=30)
    at.run()

    at.button(key='k_button').click()
    at.run()

    at.run()
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Save the code example as `test_main.py`
2. Run `pytest`

### Expected Behavior

The test runs without an error.

### Current Behavior

Running the test produces the following error message:

### Is this a regression?

- [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

Works in streamlit 1.42.1, 1.44.1, but fails for 1.45.0, 1.45.1, 1.46.1, 1.49.1

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.49.1
- pytest version: 8.4.2
- Python version: 3.11.9
- Operating System: Windows 11 Enterprise, Version 23H2, OS build 22631.5909
- Browser: _None_


### Additional Information

The error first occurred in a production example while doing changes to the widget structure of the app without any functional change. During creation of the minimal code example it became clear, that seemingly unrelated changes to the widget structure have an influence on the issue (e.g. removing the `st.container` or changing the HTML tag in `st.html` while allow the test to succeed).

The error looks very similar to the one in #9128 and the situation also shares similarity (dynamically adding / removing elements on a `st.rerun()`). I hope, my additional example might help to identify the problem.
